operating_notes.text: Delhi Airport aero revenue rose 23.8% YoY in Q1FY27 on CP4 tariffs effective 16 Apr'25, with aero yield per pax at ₹445 (+12% YoY).
GAL owned airports handled 30.5 mn passengers in Q1FY27, up 1.0% YoY, with international traffic down 2.2% and domestic up 2.0%.
Crete Airport project is 73.5% complete as of 30 Jun'26 and fully funded through a state grant and airport tax, with no debt.
September 2026: GMR portfolio handled 9,240,144 passengers (+0.9% YoY); H1FY27 58,212,317 (+0.5% YoY), the highest-ever H1.

Delhi reported highest-ever H1 volumes across total, domestic and international passengers, ATMs and cargo; Hyderabad reported highest-ever H1 cargo at ~1.02 lakh Metric Tonnes in H1 FY27 (up 5.8% YoY).
Bhogapuram Airport commenced commercial operations on 17 Aug'26 and contributed 282,999 passengers in Q2FY27; Cebu divestment completed but operates as Technical Services Provider until Dec'26.
